name: AD — Shadow Credentials (msDS-KeyCredentialLink modified)
description: Detects modification of the msDS-KeyCredentialLink attribute on an Active Directory object. Writing a Key Credential enables certificate/PKINIT-based authentication as the target (Shadow Credentials / Whisker / ESC) — a stealthy takeover and persistence primitive. This attribute changes rarely in normal operation, so any modification warrants review.
note:
## Investigation
1. `SubjectUserName` = who wrote the key credential; `ObjectDN` = the victim account (user or computer).
2. Legitimate writers are limited (Windows Hello for Business provisioning). Confirm the subject is authorised.
## Response
If unauthorised, remove the added KeyCredential, reset the affected account, and investigate the subject for compromise.
author: raadabujaish
